messages:
maria: Quick sync debating field-level validation for long console flows. Do we keep inline-only, or add a compact right-rail "error hub" after a failed save? Also want to standardize delete confirms: typed token ("DELETE"), typed resource name, or checkbox + undo. Short thoughts? alex: Hybrid vote. Inline on blur for immediacy, but when submit fails show a right-rail hub grouping errors by section (Network / Auth / Storage). Helps in multi-section forms. leah: Grouping is helpful. Make each hub item a real button that smooth-scrolls and focuses the control, and ensure the inline message is exposed. On mobile the hub should collapse into a top banner. sam: Accessibility: announce the hub assertively on submit fail (aria-live=assertive). Each hub button needs aria-controls or data-focus-target so we can set aria-describedby on focus. Example pattern: ```
Save prevented 2 problems found. Press Tab to jump to the first issue.
``` jordan: Required-marker proposal: explicit "Required" helper text for critical fields, soft asterisk for others, and never rely on color alone. Also ensure icon contrast meets AA. maria: Delete UX: three tiers. Low-impact: plain confirm modal. Medium: checkbox + 8-12s undo toast. High-impact: short typed token (type "DELETE") not full resource name. Short token reduces friction. tyler: Usability note: testers disliked typing long resource names. Short token was fastest and still felt deliberate. If we do typed token, autofocus input and include clear label (not just placeholder). leah: Implementation items: SideErrorHub component that takes groupedErrors: string[], focusTargets: string[], collapsedOnMobile: bool. When anchor clicked: expand section, smooth-scroll, focus, add aria-describedby. Avoid layout shifts by reserving space for the rail on desktop. sam: E2E checklist: aria-live announcement assertive, hub items focus target tests, toast role=status and keyboard-focusable undo, contrast checks. maria: Copy options for hub header: "Save prevented 2 problems found" or "Couldnt save 2 items to fix". Prefer action-first language. I'll draft variants in the doc. aria-bot: Preview build: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/ux/error-hub - feature flag: error_hub_experiment=true maria: OK next steps: alex -> prototype SideErrorHub; leah -> accessibility checklist; sam -> add e2e asserts; jordan -> quick hallway test Tue. I'll collect copy and send a short survey. Thanks!
